'''The Gift''' is the 38th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 9 November 2018. The set consists of 10 virtual cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*2 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*2 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*4 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Hirogen, 1 Kazon, and 3 Klingon)

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*10 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
